title: Your account status
intro: This is where your registration stands right now.
closedNotice: Signing out is the only action available on this account.

description.PendingVerification: We emailed a 6-digit code to the address you registered with. Your account reaches administrator review once you confirm it.
description.PendingApproval: Your email address is confirmed and an administrator is reviewing your registration.
description.ApprovedPendingMeeting: An administrator approved your registration. An onboarding meeting is still to be recorded before the rest of the platform opens to you.
description.Approved: Your account is approved, so every destination your role permits is open to you.
description.Rejected: Your registration was not accepted, so no other part of the platform is open to you.
description.Suspended: Your account is suspended, so no other part of the platform is open to you.
description.Deactivated: Your account is deactivated, so no other part of the platform is open to you.

nextStep.PendingVerification: Enter the 6-digit code from that email.
nextStep.PendingApproval: Wait for the review to finish. You will be emailed once a decision is taken.
nextStep.ApprovedPendingMeeting: Arrange your onboarding meeting with the administrator who approved you.
nextStep.Approved: Continue to any destination in the navigation.
nextStep.Rejected: Contact support if you believe this decision is a mistake.
nextStep.Suspended: Contact support to find out how access can be restored.
nextStep.Deactivated: Contact support if this account needs to be reopened.
